headline: OCC Issues Final Rule on Stablecoin Rewards Under GENIUS Act
summary: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency became the first federal agency to finalize regulations governing stablecoin rewards in compliance with the GENIUS Act.
why: The OCC is the primary federal regulator overseeing the safety and soundness of national banks and federal savings associations in the United States.

impacts.name: Banking & Digital Assets
impacts.why: Clear regulatory frameworks from federal banking authorities shape compliance requirements for stablecoin issuers and banks.
